articles.title: NASA Improves Shock, Vibration Analysis
articles.summary: Rockets vibrate, shake, and flex intensely as they climb into space, and spacecraft packed with delicate scientific instruments must survive those forces. Before any rocket leaves the ground, NASA engineers work to predict how those stresses will affect every part of a spacecraft. articles.title: NASA’s Simulated Mars Crew Marks One Year Inside Habitat
articles.summary: The four crew members in NASA’s simulated Mars mission have spent the past year living and working in isolation in a confined habitat at NASA’s Johnson Space Center in Houston.
